verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "custom summaries" under advanced call summaries, so the product itself has some way to shape notes beyond one generic format. Nothing shows how that works or that it can be tied to meeting types like discovery calls, 1:1s or standups. The meeting-type list endpoint is only an API filter, not a template mechanism, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented custom templates or saved prompts, assignment of templates per meeting type, any detail on how custom summaries are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can shape the notes with custom templates or saved prompts per meeting type (discovery call, 1:1, standup) instead of one generic format

citations.quote: Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries
